item.content:encoded:
At Perseverance Technology, we believe that great technology is built by great people. The Smart Coffee Machine is the result of close collaboration across hardware, computer vision, and software engineering.

In this post, we would like to introduce the software engineers behind the Coffee Machine division — the problem-solvers and builders dedicated to delivering a reliable, AI-powered coffee experience.

Our Software Engineers​

  • Danny Prihandoko — Software Engineer
  • Arief Satrio Budi Prasojo — Software Engineer
  • Andre Yulidiantoni — Software Engineer
  • Fadhilla Ilham Robbani — Software Engineer
  • Mareta Aliana — Software Engineer

You can connect with each member through the author profiles above — every card links to their GitHub and Instagram.
